sentences.text: S2 stated that his mother died in June and left the house on Wyvern Road to him and his brother Neil, fifty-fifty.
S2 stated that he and Neil are both executors of the estate.
S2 stated that probate has not yet been applied for because Neil refuses to sign.
S2 stated that Neil is currently living in the house and has refused entry to estate agents for a proper valuation.
S2 stated that an estate agent valued the house at approximately £280,000.
S2 stated that things between him and Neil have been 'bad'.
S2 disclosed that Neil punched him in the face on Saturday, 7 November, while arguing in the kitchen about the sale.
S2 stated that Neil broke his nose, causing blood everywhere, and S2 went to Castlebrook General A&E that night.
S2 stated that Neil hit him with a kitchen chair across his back and shoulder after punching him, resulting in bruising that lasted for a week.
S2 stated that Neil threatened to use a knife if he had one, though S2 confirmed Neil did not have or pick up a knife.
S2 stated that Neil sent texts saying S2 deserved it and was not getting a penny.
S2 stated that he has not reported the assault to the police because he believes his mother would have hated it.
S2 stated that he has the discharge letter, photos of his face taken the next day, and the will.
S2 stated his objectives are to have the house sold, the Mum's estate sorted, and for Neil to stay away from him.
S1 advised that as joint executors, both must act, but the court can be applied to to remove Neil if he does not co-operate.
S1 advised that S2 should report the assault on the 7th to the police.
S1 advised that S2 can apply to family court for a non-molestation order to stop Neil contacting him or coming near him.
S1 stated that S2 would need to send screenshots of texts, a copy of the discharge letter, photos, and the will by Monday, 30 November.
S1 stated that she would draft a letter to Neil regarding the estate and send it to S2 for approval by Wednesday, 2 December.
S1 stated that S2 would be booked for an appointment on the 9th of December.
